主要内容: SanDisk Corporation completed its acquisition of Fusion-io, Inc., as part of a merger agreement signed on June 16, 2014. The merger, finalized on July 23, 2014, involved SanDisk, Flight Merger Sub, Inc., and Fusion-io, Inc., a Delaware corporation. SanDisk acquired all issued and outstanding shares of Fusion-io through a cash tender offer of $11.25 per share, which expired on July 22, 2014. A total of 66,901,782 shares were tendered, representing approximately 61.02% of the outstanding shares, satisfying the Minimum Condition. The merger was funded by SanDisk's cash reserves and resulted in Fusion-io becoming a wholly owned subsidiary. Shares not tendered were cancelled at the effective time of the merger. The transaction was announced on July 23, 2014, following the expiration of the offer.
